What is EcoMotion? A mobility ecosystem based in Israel supporting the inception and growth of  innovation in vehicles, value chains and technologies that advance the movement of humans & goods.

EcoMotion provides a platform to interact, share knowledge and explore synergies, by bringing together startups, entrepreneurs, global companies, investors, innovation hubs, municipalities, government officials, and many more.
